Step-1:  trans-Cinnamaldehyde  
Ph–CH=CH–CHO   (9 C’s)  

With MeMgBr the Grignard reagent adds 1,2 to the aldehyde.  
Product-1:  Ph–CH=CH–CH(OH)CH₃  → 9 + 1 = 10 carbons.

Step-2:  Oxidation with PCC converts the secondary alcohol to a ketone without changing the carbon skeleton.  
Product-2:  Ph–CH=CH–COCH₃  (still 10 carbons).

Step-3:  Dimethyl(oxo)-λ⁶-sulfaneylidene)methane is dimethyl­ sulfoxonium methylide (Corey–Chaykovsky reagent).  
This ylide reacts with the α,β-unsaturated ketone at the carbonyl carbon to give an epoxide, introducing one new methylene (–CH₂–) into the three-membered ring.

Product-3: an epoxide having the skeleton  
Ph–CH=CH–C(–CH₃)–CH₂–O (epoxide ring)  
Carbon count: previous 10 + 1 new carbon = 11.

Hence product 3 contains 11 carbon atoms.

Answer: A
